_note: The FLWO 60-inch (Tillinghast) TCSGO server: Alpaca telescope/0 and focuser/0 over the DFM TCSGalil.
tcs.host is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder (a simulator: python -m robofast_core.devices.tcsgo_sim --port 5003).
Real hardware needs allow_hardware: true here AND --hardware on the command line; see docs/tcsgo.md first.
dome: false until it is confirmed that the 60-inch dome is wired to the TCS (docs/tcsgo.md, questions).
guide_rate 2.0 arcsec/s is what the legacy TCS window sets (#15) at startup; robofast never sends #15, so this only describes the TCS.
park_command, park_alt/park_az, focus_min/focus_max and min_interval are unconfirmed for the 60-inch.
name: flwo60
